column1: # The fork's branch ledger. Untracked, local only. Read by ./stack.
# Columns are TAB-separated: branch, base, intent, note.
#   branch  category prefix decides the intent category: feat/ fix/ ui/ local/
#   base    what it was cut from; a branch named here is a parent, not a leaf
#   intent  pr    = meant for an upstream PR (open one with ./stack pr <branch>)
#           local = fork-only, never PR'd; pushed to origin as a backup only
# File order is merge order for ./stack daily. It is load-bearing: feat/omp-rich-history
# must precede ui/interrupted-turn-notice (both add a MessageKind member and a
# MessageComponent branch), and the recorded rerere resolutions assume this order.
# PR numbers are deliberately absent - ./stack ls reads them live from GitHub, so they
# cannot go stale. Add a row with ./stack new, drop one by hand when its PR lands.
